reviews.text: Mark was awesome!! He didn’t make us wait forever to get our Ac running on one of the hottest Az days. He was honest and extremely knowledgeable and professional. I now have an AC expert for my house and my clients!!

Mark was so helpful with identifying the issue with our AC and getting it up and cool inside again!! — When our AC stopped working yesterday we needed someone to come check it out quickly. Other repair companies weren’t able to come by until later this evening or later this week.. Instant heating and air was able to set a time for us this morning and Mark showed up on time and got to work. We are so appreciative, thank you!!

Instant Air and Heat provided outstanding service from start to finish. The technician was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly inspect everything while clearly explaining the results. I appreciated their honesty, attention to detail, and friendly attitude. It’s great to work with a company that truly cares about customer satisfaction and quality service. Highly recommend Instant Air and Heat for anyone needing reliable HVAC service.

If Google had an option to give zillion stars, I wouldn't have thought even for 1 second. My HVAC blew off and my new tenants were moving within 2 days and these guys pulled it off despite being short on staff. They understood I was under a gun and did all in their capacity to make it work for me. No high pressure sales pitch, No BS just straight to the point and work done with perfection and professionalism. Their pricing is genuine too. Highly recommended.

I talked to six different companies. I was thinking two stage because inverter systems seemed out of my price range. Instant came in and quoted me an inverter system for basically what other outfits were offering for a two stage. There was no sales pitch, he simply listened to what I was thinking and gave me a quote. The installation was professional. I've had the new system for a few days now and am loving it. Highly recommend.
